product_metadata.title: Better Fit Machine Washable Upholstery Grade Futon Cover , Full 8-inch Loft-size, Microfiber Suede Cardinal Red
features: Machine Washable; tumble low dryer (remove promptly) or hang dry; warm iron as needed
Better Fit Futon Cover completely encases your futon mattress; two cover loft sizes; 6 to 8-inch Loft or over 8-inch Loft thick futon mattress
Available in an array of kid-proof pet-proof colors in both the microfiber soft suede texture and smooth texture twill weave
Will not show signs of wear for at least five years of normal household use; durable kid-proof pet-proof color-fast fabric; 100% polyester
Features hidden heavy duty three-sided zipper for easy on and off; real box construction with softly curved edges for a Better Fit and look
description: Redecorate and renew the look of your futon with the Better Fit Futon Cover. Enclosed with a hidden heavy duty 3-sided zipper, the Better Fit Futon Cover completely encases your futon mattress. Cool Wash Low Dryer or Line Dry. Fits standard full-size (54 wide by 75 long in Inch), queen-size (60 wide by 80 long in Inch), or twin-size (39 wide by 75 long in Inch) futon mattresses. Two cover loft sizes available so the cover Better Fits your futon mattress thickness of either six to eight-Inch or over eight-Inch. Upholstery grade fabric available in an array of kid-proof pet-proof colors in both the microfiber soft suede texture and smooth texture twill weave. Quality workmanship with all stitching stress points reinforced. Generous sizing to ensure a good fit and futon mattress actually lays flat when in the bed position. Removable futon cover fabric only, futon frame and futon mattress sold separately. The digital images we display have the most accurate color possible. However, due to differences in computer monitors, we cannot be responsible for variations in color between the actual product and your screen.
